'''1999 Decipher World Championship''' was the fourth Star Wars CCG World Championship, played 12–13 November 1999 at [[DecipherCon 1999]] in the Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia. [[Gary Carman]] (United Kingdom) defeated [[Steven Lewis]] (United States) 2 (+19) and became the first British World Champion.<ref name="trando">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/wf00p2.htm History of the World Finals], [[Trandosite]]</ref><ref name="wp">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia</ref><ref name="sw">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128144348/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/index.html Star Wars CCG World Championship], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>

The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Endor]]. Qualification was more exclusive than 1997–1998 (one player per region plus Open / Wild Card / invitational seats). Trandosite records that the regional structure drew heavy criticism and was not kept for 2000. A Wild Card tournament (100+ players) put [[John Arendt]] and James Lafferty into the World Finals; Lafferty played all three days. [[Joe Alread]] won Ironman and missed the main event for the first time.<ref name="trando" />

Day 1 (32 players, eight games): [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] led, then [[Clint Hays]]; Carman finished third after a strong close. That evening Carman lost his decks and rebuilt overnight, borrowing and adjusting Markus Wuest's Light.<ref name="trando" />

Day 2 (four games): [[Yannick Lapointe]] was the early leader; Winkelhaus and Hays took early losses. Lewis was the only undefeated and met Carman (Naboo region) in the final.

Final game 1: Carman [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] (Outer Rim Scout) against Lewis's Clak'dor VII Operative Speeder ([[Local Uprising / Liberation|Local Uprising]]). Carman won by 22. Game 2: Carman [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] inserts against Lewis [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]]. Lewis probed the Hidden Base (Security Precautions), Carman resolved Never Tell Me The Odds for 8 after Grimtaash stripped Torture, and Lewis won by 3 with Lateral Damage. Combined, Carman 2 (+19).<ref name="trando" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Site:''' [[DecipherCon 1999]], Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Dates:''' Worlds Day 1 Friday 12 November 1999; Day 2 and Final Confrontation Saturday 13 November. The convention ran 11–14 November.
* '''Field:''' 32 (4 Open + 2 Invitational + 23 Regional + 2 Wild Card + 1 defending). Thursday Wild Card: 146 Star Wars players; [[John Arendt]] and James Lafferty took the two seats.<ref name="wp" /><ref name="field">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref><ref name="thu">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000903021929/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html Lalumiere Thursday], DecipherCon '99</ref>

Official SW.03 scores after four games (Saturday).
